$comment: Template's shared Foundry settings (read by Foundry >= 7273a6b; personal projects[id] settings in your Foundry's settings.json win key by key). The region chorus is off: .foundry/regions holds 70 generated region Wardens. To turn it on, set chorus.source to "regions" here (for everyone) or projects[<template id>].chorus.source = "regions" in your Foundry settings (for you).
